verdicts.reason: Both cram every original element into the leaderboard as five narrow columns. The body copy is as loud as the headline, 'Ships late June' is squeezed into a three-line sliver, the legal text is illegibly tiny, and the small CTA is pinned into the top-right corner with no breathing room. A at least centres the sun logo and SOLSTICE wordmark in the dark brand block. In B the logo drifts off-centre and the wordmark is half-lost at the bottom of the block, while the larger headline jams against the top and bottom edges.
